Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation

Module v0.7.5Foundry v14D&D5e 6.0.5+

Fewer clicks. Less bookkeeping.
More time for the story.

Why use Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation? Tracking resources, remembering effects, doing damage math, and working through extra prompts can interrupt the story for GMs and players alike. Bring those steps together in one integrated module built to keep your game flowing. Its automations coordinate attacks, spells, saves, and effects, reducing repeated work and the competing macros and scripts that can add delays when several modules handle the same event. Dedicated integrations with Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice help those workflows run together. Built around official Wizards of the Coast content for Foundry VTT, it extends the books’ native activities and chat cards with connected prompts, resource tracking, and effect handling—giving your table more time to enjoy what happens next.

I.Class features & spells

Let the tools manage your smites, Metamagic, and maneuvers.

  • Class features where you use them. Choose smites, maneuvers, and bonus damage in attack and damage Configuration.
  • Shape spells as you cast. Select supported Metamagic options and carry those choices into saves and damage.
  • Keep resources connected. Eligible prompts use the current die size and track the uses, slots, and actions they spend.

Explore class and spell automation →

II.Roll corrections & reactions

Keep the roll.
Correct the result.

  • Keep your original dice. Switch Advantage, Normal, or Disadvantage without starting the roll over.
  • Correct the damage. Change supported damage rolls between Normal and Critical with cached dice.
  • React from the card. Use eligible Shield, Parry, and Inspiration prompts where the attack or damage appears.

Explore roll controls →

III.Spell Regions

Let spell areas
do the work.

  • Make the area matter. Trigger configured activities on entry, movement, or turn-start/end events.
  • Keep targets and effects together. Track affected creatures, prompt saves, and resolve configured damage and effects.
  • Let concentration handle cleanup. Linked Regions and their managed effects clear when concentration ends.

Explore spell Regions →

IV.Your table, your settings

Automate at
your table’s pace.

  • Choose your level of assistance. Enable automatic damage, healing, and effect application independently.
  • Keep manual control. Use card controls when the table needs to make a decision or correction.
  • Undo before you adjust. Reverse tracked damage or effects, correct the result, and apply again.

Explore application and Undo →

V.Guided PC creation

Build characters
with a guide.

  • Start with the essentials. Set the character’s name, ownership, and ability scores using Standard Array or 27-point buy.
  • Build from your enabled sources. Use native class, background, and species choices with Foundry’s advancement flow.
  • Finish the setup and fill your spell list. Choose equipment and spells in the character wizard. For full-list casters such as Clerics and Druids, the sheet’s Add Spell button also offers to load missing available spells automatically, ready to prepare.

Before you install

Sources, compatibility
and installation.

Built around official content for Foundry VTT

This module enhances and automates the skills, class features, feats, and spells supplied by official Wizards of the Coast content for Foundry VTT, featured in the official Foundry VTT Marketplace. Supported sources include, but are not limited to, the Player’s Handbook, Dungeon Master’s Guide, and more. It builds on those items’ native activities, effects, and rolls. The books and their content are separate purchases and are not included with this module.

Compatibility matters

Designed for the native D&D5e workflow. This module is not compatible with many other automation systems, including Midi-QOL, or the automation macros attached to items brought in through D&D Beyond Importer. Avoid combining those automations with this module on the same items and rolls.

Most enhancements use the system’s standard attack, save, and damage cards. Modules or macros that replace or significantly modify those core cards can change or interrupt automated effects, prompts, and result updates. Imported items may also need their activities and effects adjusted to match the official content.

Required modules

Install and enable Automated Conditions 5e (AC5E) and Dice So Nice! alongside Ugmul’s 5.5e Automation. Both are required for the supported automation workflow and are listed as dependencies when installing the module.

In development · manual installation

5.5e Automation is still in development and is not yet listed in the Foundry VTT package directory. Install it from Foundry’s Setup screen: Add-on Modules → Install Module, paste the manifest link from Module resources into Manifest URL, then select Install. Once installed, Foundry can track the module and check for updates through that manifest.
